adopted_design_implications: Use explicit schema dialects and closed-field behavior for advisory envelopes.
Model provenance separately from proof or validation.
Use digest and attestation language as traceability only, not as scientific evidence.
Keep metadata, BOM, and catalog standards as governance comparators.
Use deterministic serialization only to stabilize hashes and lineage, not to prove claims.
